criteria.evidence: At HEAD e3ea8e0, tests/terminal-idle-diagnostics.test.mjs contains the POSIX CLI regression for a ready, connected, writable, non-orphaned Agy terminal whose tui-idle check times out. It records the fake Orca argv and asserts that tui-idle was requested while orchestration worker-start was never called. The supplied full-suite receipt includes this test and reports 1,218 pass, 0 fail.

The runtime reference at e3ea8e0 keeps the preflight rule that a timeout creates no Dispatch and requires terminal-idle-check before workflow-reserve. Its approved injection exception remains limited to a user-approved --inject-fallback for an Agy timeout, rejects Claude and Codex before Orca is called, and records unsupervised and model-proof limitations.

Corrective commit e2f636b is an ancestor of e3ea8e0 and records the 2026-09-30 Orca 1.4.217 timeout, receipt df61f4ae-0d24-4378-a330-f29b04f860dc, and no-Dispatch outcome in orca-runtime.md. Merged commit 43a4050 adds docs/plan/147-agy-path.md, preserving that timeout alongside the later official-path result.

orca orchestration worker-show for ctx_7117f2ebd635 reports Dispatch completed, worker state succeeded and stage settled for task_28b11709d607 on term_652dcc42-a155-4070-8072-8c782f2c883c. The persisted issue-147-agy-probe state and attach/settle events agree on the same dispatch, run, task, worktree, worker-start path, requested gemini-3.1-pro-high model, and settled outcome.

/tmp/omt-147-test.log is a valid npm test receipt for package 2.11.3: 1,255 tests, 1,218 pass, 0 fail, 37 skipped, duration 69,987.142708 ms, SHA-256 397924b362272411ac5ae3653eba133d47aadc1a50c3528a951cc1c0a6e1565d. Its mtime is 2026-10-06 13:28:28 +0900, before 43a4050 at 13:32:25 and the reviewed merge HEAD e3ea8e0 at 13:33:22, so the receipt does not prove a full suite run at the exact reviewed HEAD.
